notes.title: We have added an undo feature!
notes.content: [h2]Introduction[/h2][p]As we were asked by one review and some testers, we have added an undo feature to the game![/p][p]This feature is a bit experimental, so if you find any bug, please let us know.[/p][h2]How does it work?[/h2][p]You will see a new button on top of the screen whenever you can undo an action, this is triggered by learning and forgetting. This should help you go back before making an error that leaves you stranded, like forgetting how to walk![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45513377/289863ae3b756b160ea8f7c060820453b45d51cc.png"][/img][/p][p]We of course also let you use control z for this![/p]
